id.title: Company ID
id.description: Identifier of the company. Typically unique within this dataset.

name.title: Company Name
name.description: Official name of the company including company suffixes such as Ltd, Inc, Corp, LLC, SE, GmbH, AG, SARL, or SAS.

founded.title: Founding Date
founded.description: Date when the company was founded in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

country.title: Country
country.description: Name of the country where the company is headquartered. The names should be expressed using the CLDR standard.

city.title: City
city.description: City where the company is headquartered.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: Primary industry in which the company operates.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Total assets of the company in US$, represented as a non-negative integer.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.description: Total revenue of the company in US$, represented as a non-negative integer.

founders.title: Founders
founders.description: List of the founders of the company. The list should only contain the founders and not other key persons associated with the company.

FounderName.title: Founder Name
FounderName.description: Name of a founder of the company. The name consists of a first name followed by the last name of the founder.
